data.change_summary: No further fixes were applied in this stage. The seventh review approved the latest remediation as-is, so the codebase remained unchanged and this pass only records that the remaining notes were non-blocking follow-ups outside the required scope of this bead.
outstanding_risks: Legacy process field names such as `plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total`, `aob_k_tan_mg`, and `decomposer_k_doc_mg` still read like total-mass parameters even though runtime semantics now normalize them onto concentration- or area-based units; that rename work remains deferred to downstream normalization beads.

Plant guild competition is still order-dependent because guilds consume shared nutrients sequentially in array order; this is currently an accepted model property, not a defect addressed in this bead.

Schema-2 save migration still assumes legacy dissolved totals were authored against gross water volume, so a hand-edited or previously pre-migrated schema-2 file could still be rescaled again on load.
